CustomJoint.kinematic_program: source-derived canonical FunctionBased binary sidecars have bounded Metal pose, H, Hdot, H-transpose wrench projection, and Hdot times qdot primitives; the pinned CPU FP64 reference admits immutable FunctionBasedJointProgram records into analytic Jacobian mass/bias and state advance; MetalWorld executes the bounded fixed-root dense source dynamics path, source Millard effort reduction, and source-mass streamed temporal-cone response columns against resident q/v/effort state.
CustomJoint.cpu_reference_payload: The provenance-locked 22-body Rajagopal rigid tree can load source mass, inertia, COM, joint-frame, coordinate, and FunctionBased-program records into the FP64 reference probe.
CustomJoint.requirement: The bounded path is one fixed-root direct-effort articulation in free motion or temporal-cone contact using source-mass streamed responses. The contact probe uses synthetic plane/sphere colliders only; BodyParts3D frame registration, anatomical collision/material calibration, multi-articulation composition, native task/policy binding, and mobile/joint-class extensions remain separate gates.

UniversalJoint.requirement: Represent a source-faithful coupled two-axis joint in the articulated solver.

fully_locked_zero_default_lowering.condition: All source coordinates are locked and have exactly zero default value, so the source joint transform is its fixed zero-coordinate transform.

muscle_tendon.current_contract_evidence: The FP64 source bridge and MetalWorld execute source-parameterized curves, static fiber-tendon equilibrium, finite-cylinder GeometryPath wrapping with each source PathWrap method and range, and one generalized-force vector per muscle. MetalWorld reduces those device-only vectors into its resident effort arena before bounded FunctionBased free motion or the synthetic streamed temporal-cone contact probe; no CPU force restaging occurs.
muscle_tendon.persistent_activation_reference: Core supplies a deterministic first-order persistent activation update with explicit caller-owned time constants and fiber-length warm-start storage. The imported Rajagopal source contract does not yet materialize those constants or execute this state on device.
